cohort: The study included 190 Indian women (95 who had cesarean deliveries and 95 who had vaginal deliveries) from a tertiary care hospital.
finding: Maternal urban residence, short stature, obesity, comorbidities, inadequate antenatal care, and below poverty line status were significant predictors of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Maternal urban residence, short stature, obesity, comorbidities, inadequate antenatal care, and below poverty line status were identified as important predictors of cesarean delivery.
